# Tailornova

> Tailornova is a web-based 3D fashion design and pattern-making platform enabling custom-fit clothing creation with advanced configurators for made-to-measure and on-demand manufacturing.

Tailornova provides designers and fashion brands with cloud-based tools to create, customize, and manufacture clothing digitally. The platform integrates CAD capabilities, FitModel™ technology for accurate sizing, and configurators for e-commerce integration, serving both individual designers and educational institutions.

## Key Topics

- 3D Fashion Design
- FitModel™ Technology
- Made-to-Measure (MTM)
- Pattern Making
- 3D Configurators
- CAD Integration
- On-Demand Manufacturing
- Fashion Customization
- DXF/PDF Export
- E-commerce Integration
- PatternFast AI
- StyleCustomizer
- Web-based Design Tool
- Custom-Fit Patterns
- Fashion Design Software

## Core Products & Features

- [Design your own clothes in seconds | Tailornova](https://tailornova.com/explore): 3D clothing design tool with custom-fit patterns and FitModel technology for real-time garment visualization
- [Create your own End-to-end 3D Fashion Configurators](https://tailornova.com/3d-configurators): 3D fashion configurators for MTM and on-demand manufacturing with CAD integration and e-commerce capabilities
- [Tailornova | Online clothing design software](https://tailornova.com): Homepage featuring Tailornova's 3D fashion design platform with FitModel and StyleCustomizer tools
